item.title: Effectiveness per Tax Dollar: Austin ISD vs. Texas’s Big Districts
item.description: Austin ISD raises and spends the most per pupil of Texas’s big urban districts — and posts the best results. It also sends roughly half its local property taxes back to the state, and that single fact can flip its efficiency ranking from last toward the top.
